title: PDF is a consumer, not a font authority
summary: ooRexx PDF dev6 consumes FontRunPlan through PdfManagedFontSet: the report corpus is planned once, actually used faces are subset and embedded independently, and each drawn string is segmented against the precomputed face assignment.
invariants: PdfFlowReport may consume an injected FontManager but must not search the host font filesystem itself.
FontManager selects PRINT_BODY/HEADING faces, creates subsets and provides glyph plans.
PDF owns CID allocation, /Identity-H, /CIDToGIDMap, /ToUnicode and PDF object syntax.
Unicode metadata and outline titles use Unicode PDF strings independently from font discovery.
The legacy Helvetica path remains available when no FontManager is injected.
PDF dev6 may embed multiple managed faces for each semantic role and splits text into stable runs without repeating discovery during wrapping.
The current PDF emitter requires TrueType because it emits CIDFontType2/FontFile2; CFF/OpenType must remain unsupported until a correct CIDFontType0/OpenType emitter exists.

provenance.claim: PDF dev5 shared Font Manager integration and CID TrueType/ToUnicode qualification contract.
PDF adapter requests subset and glyph plan from FontManager and delegates measurement to that plan.
PDF-specific font embedding, CID map, widths and ToUnicode object construction.
PdfManagedFontSet consumes FontRunPlan, embeds one subset per used face and performs preplanned run segmentation/measurement.
